verdict.rationale: Klaviyo is an email/SMS marketing platform, so automatic suppression of unsubscribes, bounces, and spam complaints is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack contains nothing about suppression lists, unsubscribe handling, bounce or complaint processing, or CAN-SPAM/GDPR compliance. The items present cover APIs, SDKs, the MCP server, pricing, and AI features only.
